####################################################################################################
## SECTION 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW & TECH STACK
####################################################################################################

This workspace unifies a complete, privacy-first Android TV / Google TV debloating, replacement launcher,
modular add-on, phone companion, and hardware verification ecosystem rooted at `D:\official tv app`.
Previously housed at `d:\emmanuel\new tv app`, all workspace directories and git repositories were moved intact to `D:\official tv app`.

### 1.1 Workspace Subsystems & Architecture
1. **VYNTRA TV Launcher (`tv-launcher/`)**:
   - Package / Application ID: `com.emmanuel.tvhome`, **v7.2 (`versionCode 72`)** (uncommitted working tree on top of git `cb6db3b` / tag `2.0-remote-settings`).
   - Role: Primary standalone offline Android TV / Google TV Home replacement launcher (`android.intent.category.HOME`, `DEFAULT`, `LEANBACK_LAUNCHER`).
   - Network Policy: **Zero `INTERNET` permission**; zero cloud calls, zero telemetry, zero ads.
   - Architecture: Pure Android SDK Activity + RecyclerView + custom Canvas `Drawable`/`View` glass rendering + SpringAnimation physics (`androidx.dynamicanimation`) + two `AccessibilityService` helpers (`HomeKeyService`, `InputKeyService`) + one `NotificationListenerService` (`GuardRevival`) + two `ContentProvider`s (`ThemeProvider`, `WallpaperBridgeProvider`) + one `DreamService` (`ClockDream`). No Dagger/Hilt/RxJava/Compose/Retrofit/Glide bloat.

2. **Wallpaper Sync Companion Add-on (`tv-launcher/addons/wallpaper-sync/` and `addons/wallpaper-sync/`)**:
   - Application ID: `com.emmanuel.wallpapersync` (`versionCode 1`, `versionName 1.0`, ~38.8 KB APK).
   - Role: Allows users to push custom Home & Screensaver wallpapers from any phone/laptop browser over local Wi-Fi without ADB.
   - Architecture: Foreground service (`SyncServerService`) running a custom pure-Java HTTP/1.1 `ServerSocket` (`WallpaperHttpServer`, port `8765`), serving an inline single-page responsive Web UI (`WebUi`), QR pairing code (`Qr`/`QrView`), 4-digit PIN auth (`MessageDigest.isEqual`), pushing images <=15 MB via signature-protected `ContentResolver` IPC (`WallpaperBridgeProvider`).

3. **Offline TV Companion Mirror App (`companion/`) & TV Server (`tv_server/`)**:
   - Phone App ID: `com.companion.tvmirror` (`versionCode 1`, `versionName 1.0`, **43,176 B** release APK vs 10 MB budget).
   - TV Server: `tv_server/tv-server.jar` (~7.6 KB Dalvik DEX compiled with `javac` + `d8`, launched via `app_process` under unprivileged shell UID 2000).
   - Architecture: Full-duplex single-TCP-socket LAN protocol on port `55555` (`TCP_NODELAY`, `SO_KEEPALIVE`) streaming raw hardware-encoded H.264/AVC Annex-B from `/system/bin/screenrecord` into Android `MediaCodec` (`KEY_LOW_LATENCY = 1` -> `SurfaceView`), while upstream newline-terminated JSON frames inject D-pad keys, taps, swipes, and text via `InputManager` reflection or `/system/bin/input`.

4. **CleanYourTV Phone Orchestrator (`cleanyourtv-app/`)**:
   - Version: `0.4.8` (bundled APKs `cleanyourtv-app-v6.3-compat-release.apk`, `cleanyourtv-app-v6.4-release.apk`).
   - Role: Pure phone-based TV cleaner with zero computer/CLI needed, shipping 173 TV bloat lists across 47 brands, MVI finite state machines, in-process TLS/RSA ADB client (`adb:wire`, `adb:pairing`, `adb:session`), bundled signed APKs (`cleanyourtv-launcher.apk`, `cleanyourtv-curtain.apk` with `.minisig` signatures), restore points, and full rollback.

5. **Upstream Launcher (`launcher/`) & Liquid Glass Variant (`liquid-glass-launcher/`)**:
   - `launcher/`: CleanYourTV base (`com.gathin.tvhome`, 88 Java classes, includes `RecentApps` / `RecentAppsActivity`).
   - `liquid-glass-launcher/`: Experimental variant (`com.gathin.tvhome.liquidglass`, 86 Java classes including `LiquidGlass`, `Frost`, `GlassPanelDrawable`, `GlassPillDrawable` leveraging Android 12+ `RenderEffect` blur).

6. **Community Add-ons Catalog (`addons/`, 35 add-ons)**:
   - 34 Java/SDK-light TV add-ons + 1 Kotlin add-on (`tv-hub`) exposing Spec-1 `module_card.xml` home cards, system Daydreams, Quick Tiles, overlays, and smart-home/media utilities.

7. **Themes (`themes/`), Tooling (`tools/`), Verification Tests (`tests/`), Device DB (`examples/` + `docs/`), Hardware Backups (`backup/`), Screenshots (`shots/`), Knowledge Graph (`graphify-out/`)**:
   - Complete CLI, testing, benchmarking (`trace.py`, `flamechart.py`, `screendiff.py`, `bench.py`), theme injection (`theme.sh`/`theme.ps1`), and documentation ecosystem.

####################################################################################################
## SECTION 3. FEATURES & MODULES IMPLEMENTED
####################################################################################################

### 3.1 VYNTRA TV Launcher (`tv-launcher`, `com.emmanuel.tvhome` v7.2)
- **tvOS-Style Home Screen (`MainActivity`, `AppAdapter`, `DockDecoration`, `DockSlots`, `Order`)**:
  - Supports configurable grid columns (4–7), `rows_below_dock` (0+), `single_row` mode, pinned `dock_apps`, `fill_dock` auto-fill, frosted/solid/floating dock band (`dock_glass`, `dock_band`, `dock_band_all`, `dock_opacity` 30%–100%, `dock_even_padding` concentric corner math), uniform icon tiles (`uniform_tiles` + `Tint` icon palette extraction), and atomic drag/D-pad reorder state persistence (`Order` writing `order.txt`).
  - **Launcher Settings Shortcut Card (Added in v7.2)**: `AppAdapter.Entry.LAUNCHER_SETTINGS` (kind `4`) appends a dedicated Launcher Settings tile at the end of the app grid (`ic_home_settings`), excluded from tile reordering (`movableCount()` keeps `LAUNCHER_SETTINGS` and `HOME_SETTINGS` anchored last), and triggers `TileListener.onOpenLauncherSettings(card)` -> `MainActivity.onOpenLauncherSettings` with `WindowMorph` origin bounds.
  - **Long-Press Action Menu (`tile_menu` in `MainActivity.onTileLongPress`)**: Hold OK / `KEYCODE_MENU` on any tile opens a floating glass menu (`Replace with another app` / `Add to dock`, `Move`, `Remove from Home`, `App info`, `Uninstall` via `ACTION_DELETE` + `REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES` for user apps or `Disable` for system apps).
- **Liquid-Glass Highlight & Motion Physics (`GlassView`, `AdaptiveGlassDrawable`, `Motion`, `WindowMorph`, `TopFade`)**:
  - `GlassView` renders an offscreen hardware-layered highlight (`glass`, `rim`, `halo` styles) driven by dual `SpringAnimation`s (`springX`, `springY`) between tiles.
  - `AdaptiveGlassDrawable` paints the 6.3-style frosted sheen (`#2EFFFFFF` -> `#14FFFFFF`), `1dp` `#38FFFFFF` rim, and `#F5FFFFFF` solid focus state across top-bar pills and rows.
  - `WindowMorph` animates activity & popup openings (`QuickSettingsActivity`, `NotificationPanelActivity`, `LauncherSettingsActivity`, `AppLibraryDialog`) from exact source View screen bounds & corner radius (`EXTRA_LEFT/TOP/RIGHT/BOTTOM/RADIUS`, `340ms` `apple_decelerate` `PathInterpolator(0.16, 1.0, 0.30, 1.0)`) via RenderNode scaling & `ViewOutlineProvider` clipping with mid-flight reversal support and zero per-frame layout passes.
- **15 Granular Per-Animation ON/OFF Toggles (Added in v7.2)**:
  - Managed via `Config.isAnimEnabled(ctx, key)` backed by `SharedPreferences("launcher_settings")`, exposed as 15 dynamic rows in `LauncherSettingsActivity.ANIM_TOGGLE_SPECS` (`row_anim_toggle.xml` inflated into `@id/animTogglesContainer`, dimmed at `alpha=0.45` when global `animations` is OFF):
    1. `anim_window_morph` — **Window Morph** (`QuickSettingsActivity`, `LauncherSettingsActivity`, `NotificationPanelActivity`, `AppLibraryDialog`, `MainActivity.openOwnedActivity`).
    2. `anim_app_transitions` — **App Open / Close Transition** (`AppAdapter.launch`, `AppLibraryDialog`, `MainActivity`, `HomeKeyService`).
    3. `anim_screensaver_transition` — **Screensaver Transition** (`MainActivity.openScreensaver`, `ClockActivity`, `QuickSettingsActivity`).
    4. `anim_button_springs` — **Top Bar & Button Springs** (`Motion.attachSpringFocus` on `MainActivity` top pills, `LauncherSettingsActivity` rows/chips, `NotificationPanelActivity`).
    5. `anim_tile_focus` — **Tile Focus Spring & Zoom** (`AppAdapter` card lift, scale `1.10x`/`1.12x`, banner zoom, label slide).
    6. `anim_launch_press` — **App Launch Press Feedback** (`AppLaunchController` + `AppAdapter.launch`).
    7. `anim_glass_pill` — **Liquid-Glass Focus Pill** (`MainActivity` `glass` highlight fade & spring motion).
    8. `anim_menu_popup` — **Dropdown Menu Spring** (`HomeMenus.dropIn`, `MainActivity` tile menu popup).
    9. `anim_home_entrance` — **Home Entrance Transition** (`MainActivity.playGatherTransition` on resume).
    10. `anim_tile_stagger` — **Tile Stagger Entrance** (`MainActivity` grid `LayoutAnimationController` + `@anim/tile_enter`).
    11. `anim_hero_crossfade` — **Hero Title & Art Crossfade** (`MainActivity` `hero` title slide/fade & `applyHeroArt` crossfade).
    12. `anim_ambient_glow` — **Ambient Dock Glow** (`MainActivity` `transitionAmbient` color fades).
    13. `anim_wallpaper_caption` — **Wallpaper Caption Fade** (`WallpaperPlayer` crossfade when rotating captions).
    14. `anim_clock_screensaver` — **Clock Screensaver Entry & Drift** (`ClockScene` entrance spring & 60s OLED burn-in drift fade).
    15. `anim_icon_effects` — **Bell & Festival Icon Animations** (`BellDrawable`, `MarigoldDrawable`, `DiyaDrawable`, `JackOLanternDrawable`, `SpookyIconDrawable`, `PetalShowerView`, `BatFlightView`).
- **Separate Toggleable UI Settings in `LauncherSettingsActivity`**:
  - Independent ON/OFF switches for **Wallpaper**, **Screensaver**, **Screensaver Month Calendar**, **Animations (Master)**, all **15 Individual Animations**, **Advanced Effects**, **Top Bar System Stats**, **Inputs Pill**, and **Network Pill**, plus selectors for **Columns (4/5/6/7)**, **Dock Opacity (100/70/50/30%)**, **Clock Format (System/12h/24h)**, **Choose Home / Screensaver Wallpaper**, **Launch Wallpaper Sync**, **Button Mapper**, **Show/Hide App Cards**, **Reorder Apps**, **Follow Theme**, **Default Home**, and **TV System Settings**.
- **Hero, Ambient Glow, Time-of-Day Sky & Festivals (`HeroArt`, `Accent`, `Sky`, `SkyView`, `Sun`, `Festival`)**:
  - Restored Hero (`cinematic_home=true`) and Ambient Glow (`ambient_glow=true`, `app_glow=true`, `glow_style="horizon"`) extract brand accent colors asynchronously (`LauncherExecutors.io()` -> bounded LRU cache) and wash them across the top edge and shelf.
  - `Sky` + `SkyView` render a `240x135` bitmap gradient once per minute using solar sunrise/sunset geometry (`Sun.riseAndSet`), avoiding expensive full-screen redraws on weak TV GPUs.
  - Built-in festival overlays (`Festival`: Diwali diyas/marigolds/petal shower; Halloween jack-o'-lanterns/spooky pills/bats; configurable via `festival` / `festival_until`).
- **Live Clock, Calendars, System Telemetry & Sports/Race Panels**:
  - `LiveClockView`: Zero-allocation wall-clock ticker with baseline-aligned seconds (`RelativeSizeSpan(0.62f)`), full `100%` opacity light/regular font styling (`#FFFFFFFF`), resilient across standby/screen-on broadcasts and display listener updates.
  - Optional `ShamsiDate` (Solar Hijri), `Lunar` (Vietnamese/Chinese lunisolar via Meeus astronomy), `SystemStats` (live RAM MB + free storage GB), `RaceWeekend` (F1 sessions), and `GameDay` (ContentResolver query to add-on).
- **Built-in Quick Settings (`QuickSettingsActivity`) & Sleep Timer (`SleepTimer`)**:
  - 290dp translucent right-side overlay triggered by remote gear/settings keys (`80`, `83`, `KEYCODE_SETTINGS`) or menu actions: Tiles for **Screensaver**, **Inputs**, **Display**, **Sound**, **Wi-Fi**, **Bluetooth**, **Sleep timer** (AlarmManager `setWindow` 15..120 min steps -> `GLOBAL_ACTION_LOCK_SCREEN`), **Reorder apps**, **Notifications**, and **All settings**.
- **Built-in Notification Center (`NotificationPanelActivity` + `GuardRevival`)**:
  - `NotificationListenerService` caching up to `MAX_CAPACITY = 20` eligible notifications (`!FLAG_ONGOING_EVENT && !FLAG_GROUP_SUMMARY`) without retaining heavy bitmaps; OK opens `PendingIntent`, long-press OK dismisses item, `Clear all` wipes list.
- **Standalone Screensaver (`ClockActivity`, `ClockDream`, `ClockScene`, `MonthCalendarView`)**:
  - Fullscreen clock + seconds + optional active `MonthCalendarView` over dimmed Home wallpaper (`clock_wallpaper_dim=50%`) or rotating discrete 16-step low-power ambient glow; 60-second OLED drift; triggered manually, as Android System `DreamService`, or after `home_idle_clock_minutes=5` on Home (never interrupting Live TV/apps).
- **Accessibility Key Services, Self-Healing & Interactive Button Mapper**:
  - `HomeKeyService` & `InputKeyService` intercept physical remote scancodes/keycodes (`RemoteKeys` parsing `scan:`, `hold:`, `front:`, `guide:`, `input:`, action words `back/home/recents/mute/sleep/screensaver/settings/panel/quick_settings/notifications/wifi/library/ignore`).
  - `ButtonMapper` provides an in-UI key detector and remap list with `isProtectedKey()` safety locks (D-pad, Enter, Back, Home, Vol, Power cannot be overwritten), deduplication (`lastHandledKeyCode` + `lastHandledEventTime`), and JSON backup/restore (`button_mappings.json`).
  - `ServiceRepair`, `GuardKeep`, `DirectBoot`, and `RestoreKeyServices` auto-heal disabled accessibility services after force-stops or reboots (`WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS`).
- **App Library (`AppLibraryDialog`, `LibraryApps`, `LibraryLoads`)**: Full grid modal showing all installed Android & Leanback apps, hide/show toggles, add/remove from Home, and app launch.
- **Module Cards (`Cards`, `CardFeature`, `ModuleCardController`)**: Signed-certificate-pinned plugin card discovery (`com.emmanuel.tvhome.category.DOCK_CARD`, `cards.json`) with user consent prompt and strict XML/ASCII bounds.

### 3.2 Wallpaper Sync Companion Add-on (`tv-launcher/addons/wallpaper-sync` & `addons/wallpaper-sync`)
- **API Endpoints (`WallpaperHttpServer.java` on port `8765..8774`)**:
  - `GET /` -> Serves embedded single-page responsive Web UI (`WebUi.HTML`, auto-scales >10 MB images in browser canvas, persists PIN in `localStorage`).
  - `GET /api/status` -> Returns JSON status of Home & Screensaver wallpapers and timestamps from `WallpaperBridgeProvider`.
  - `POST /api/wallpaper?target={home|screensaver|both}` (Header `X-PIN: <4-digit>`) -> Validates constant-time PIN via `MessageDigest.isEqual`, enforces `1 B..15 MB` Content-Length & magic header check (JPEG/PNG/WebP), streams via `WallpaperBridgeProvider` `ContentResolver` IPC.
  - `POST /api/clear?target={home|screensaver|both}` (Header `X-PIN: <4-digit>`) -> Clears custom wallpaper back to theme default.

### 3.3 Offline LAN Mirror & Remote (`companion/` & `tv_server/`)
- **Protocol v1.0 (`tv_server/protocol.md`, TCP port `55555`)**:
  - Client connects over Wi-Fi (`LocalWifiManager` calls `connectivityManager.bindProcessToNetwork(wifiNetwork)` without `NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET` so cellular never hijacks offline LAN routers).
  - `IpValidator` permits only RFC 1918 (`10/8`, `172.16/12`, `192.168/16`), Link-Local (`169.254/16`), and Loopback (`127/8`).
  - Handshake (`5000 ms` `SoTimeout`): Client sends `{"t":"hello","token":"123456","profile":"720p60","fps":60}\n`; Server responds `{"ok":true,"width":1280,"height":720,"fps":60,"refresh_hz":60,"token_ok":true}\n` or closes socket with `{"ok":false,"token_ok":false}`.
  - Profiles: `540p60` (960x540 @ 3 Mbps), `720p60` (1280x720 @ 5 Mbps), `1080p60` (1920x1080 @ 9 Mbps).
  - Downstream Video: Raw H.264/AVC Annex-B stream (`0x00000001` / `0x000001`) from `/system/bin/screenrecord --output-format=h264 --time-limit 0 -` -> `NalParser` (4 MB safety cap, caches SPS NAL 7 / PPS NAL 8) -> `VideoDecoder` (`MediaCodec`, `video/avc`, `KEY_LOW_LATENCY = 1` -> `SurfaceView`) with real-time FPS & latency HUD.
  - Upstream Input: `{"t":"key","code":N}`, `{"t":"tap"}`, `{"t":"swipe","dir":"..."}`, `{"t":"text","value":"..."}` injected by `InputInjector` via reflected `InputManager.injectInputEvent(event, 0)` (fallback `/system/bin/input`).

### 3.4 `cleanyourtv-app` Android Phone Orchestrator
- Clean modular graph enforced by `build-logic` (`checkModuleGraph`, `AndroidApiCheckTask`, `ApkSizeCheckTask`):
  - Pure JVM domain/protocol core: `:core:model`, `:core:spec`, `:core:ops`, `:core:probe`, `:core:planner`, `:core:engine`, `:core:trust`, `:core:registry`, `:core:backup`, `:core:flows`, `:adb:wire` (custom ADB frame/TLS/RSA protocol), `:adb:pairing` (wireless debugging PAKE/TLS pairing), `:adb:session` (`PmGuardWatchdog`, session recovery).
  - Android edge & Compose UI: `:android:platform` (NsdDiscovery, KeystoreAdbSigner, SecretBox, FileBlobStore, bundled `cleanyourtv-launcher.apk` & `cleanyourtv-curtain.apk` with `.minisig` signatures), `:android:work` (`OperationService`), `:ui:design` (verified Compose stability check), `:feature:connect`, `:feature:setup`, `:feature:manage`, `:feature:launcher`, `:feature:modules`, `:feature:backup`, `:app`, `:benchmark`, `:tv:curtain`.

####################################################################################################
## SECTION 4. CODE LOGIC & CONFIGURATION DETAILS
####################################################################################################

### 4.1 Key Classes, Physics Constants & Algorithms (`tv-launcher`)
- **`Config.java`**: Loads `res/values/config.xml`, merges optional external `config.json` from `Config.dir(ctx)` (via `ThemeProvider` / `b64push.py`), then overlays user overrides from `SharedPreferences("launcher_settings")`. Exposes `SETTINGS_REVISION_KEY` (`settings_revision`) so returning to `MainActivity` rebuilds views only when settings actually changed. Detects theme changes via `theme_signature` in `SharedPreferences("theme_revision")`.
- **`MainActivity.java` (3,808 lines)**: Coordinates lifecycle, `AppAdapter`, `TvInputRouter`, `HomeMenus`, `ModuleCardController`, focus springs (`glass`, `springX`, `springY`), `HeroArt` bounded LRU bitmap cache, `LiveClockView`, `WallpaperPlayer`, and `NetworkCallback`/`BroadcastReceiver` updates.
- **`WindowMorph.java` (482 lines)**: `DURATION_MS = 340L`, `MIN_SCALE = 0.02f`, cubic curve `PathInterpolator(0.16f, 1.0f, 0.30f, 1.0f)`. Precomputes `outlineLeft/Top/Right/Bottom/Radius` per animation frame without heap allocations.
- **`Motion.java` (43 lines)**: Reduced motion ceiling `REDUCED_MS = 90`, `REDUCED_STIFFNESS = 15000f`, `DAMPING_RATIO_NO_BOUNCY`, `REDUCED_MIN_CHANGE = 2f`. Standard button springs use stiffness `420f`, focus damping `0.68f`, blur damping `0.88f`.
- **`Cards.java` (864 lines)**: Enforces `SPEC_SUPPORTED = 1`, `MAX_DECLARED = 32`, `MAX_SHOWN = 8`, `MAX_RECORDS = 128`, `MAX_EVENTS = 64`, `MAX_DEPTH = 2`, `MAX_ATTRIBUTES = 16`, `LABEL_MAX = 24`, `CAPTION_MAX = 32`. Pure ASCII character loops (avoiding Android ICU regex divergence on desktop JVMs). Rejects reserved labels (`verified`, `official`, `tvvibehack`, `cleanyourtv`, `settings`, `inputs`, `livetv`, `home`, `defaulthome`, `wifi`, `av`, `hdmi*`). Pins decisions (`show`/`hide`) to APK signing certificate digest in `cards.json` (`RELABELLED` / `RESIGNED` triggers fresh user consent).
- **`SleepTimer.java`**: Steps `STEPS = {0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120}`. Uses `AlarmManager.setWindow(..., 60_000, ...)` rather than exact alarms so Android 14 never blocks on `SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM`. Validates `Settings.Global.BOOT_COUNT` to automatically reset tile state after reboot.
- **`LiveClockView.java` (329 lines)**: Zero-allocation `computeTime` formatter applying `RelativeSizeSpan(0.62f)` and `ForegroundColorSpan` for baseline-aligned seconds; ticks aligned to wall-clock second boundaries only while window is visible/focused.

### 4.2 State Management, SharedPreferences & Databases
1. **Launcher State (`tv-launcher`, No SQLite — zero DB lock/migration overhead)**:
   - `SharedPreferences("launcher_settings")`: Stores `rows_below_dock`, `wallpaper_choice`, `screensaver_wallpaper`, `screensaver_style`, `screensaver_bg`, `dock_opacity`, `clock_format`, `columns`, `wallpaper`, `animations`, `advanced_effects`, `show_stats`, `show_inputs_pill`, `show_network_pill`, `screensaver`, `screensaver_calendar`, `user_hidden_apps`, `user_shown_apps`, `settings_revision`, plus the 15 `anim_*` boolean keys.
   - `SharedPreferences("button_mappings")`: Stores `keycode -> target` mappings + `_user_cleared` marker + synced JSON backup `button_mappings.json`.
   - `SharedPreferences("sleep_timer")`: `end_elapsed`, `minutes`, `boot`.
   - `SharedPreferences("wallpaper_rotation")`: `collection`, `image`, `changed`.
   - `SharedPreferences("theme_revision")`: `theme_signature`.
   - `SharedPreferences("last_opened")`: Package launch timestamps synced from `UsageStatsManager`.
   - Flat files in `Config.dir(ctx)`: `config.json` (theme overlay), `order.txt` (app tile order), `cards.json` (Module Card signer decisions), `home_wallpaper.jpg`, `screensaver_wallpaper.jpg`.
2. **Companion App (`companion`)**:
   - `SharedPreferences("tv_companion_prefs")`: `tv_ip`, `tv_port` (`55555`), `tv_token` (`123456`), `stream_profile` (`720p60`), `fps_overlay`, `haptic_enabled`, `touch_sensitivity`, `long_press_action`.
3. **Wallpaper Sync (`wallpaper-sync`)**:
   - `SharedPreferences("wallpaper_sync")`: Stores `pairing_pin` (4-digit cryptographically random PIN via `SecureRandom`).
4. **SQLite Schema (`addons/tv-hub`, `tvhub.db` version 2, WAL enabled)**:
   - `sources(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, type TEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL, config TEXT NOT NULL, position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_refresh INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, channel_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, skipped INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, error TEXT, epg TEXT)` (`config` encrypted via `SecureStore`).
   - `streams(source_id INTEGER NOT NULL, idx INTEGER NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, number TEXT, tvg_id TEXT, tvg_name TEXT, logo TEXT, grp TEXT, url TEXT NOT NULL, ua TEXT, ref TEXT)` + `INDEX streams_source(source_id, idx)`.
   - `programmes(epg_id TEXT NOT NULL, start INTEGER NOT NULL, stop INTEGER NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, sub TEXT, descr TEXT, cat TEXT)` + `INDEX programmes_channel(epg_id, start)`.
   - `epg_names(name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, epg_id TEXT NOT NULL)`, `favorites(channel_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, added INTEGER NOT NULL)`, `recents(channel_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, at INTEGER NOT NULL)`.

### 4.3 IPC ContentProviders, Permissions & Manifest Configurations (`tv-launcher`)
- **Manifest (`tv-launcher/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`)**:
  - Custom signature-level permission: `com.emmanuel.tvhome.permission.WALLPAPER_SYNC` (`protectionLevel="signature"`).
  - Permissions requested: `QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES`, `PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS` (protectedSettings), `REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES`, `WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS` (granted via ADB `RESTORE_KEY_SERVICES=1`), `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE`, `ACCESS_WIFI_STATE`, `RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED`. **Zero `INTERNET` permission.**
  - Providers:
    - `ThemeProvider` (`com.emmanuel.tvhome.theme`, `android:writePermission="android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS"`): Allows `tools/theme.sh` / `b64push.py` to update `config.json` & wallpapers on scoped-storage Android 11/14 TVs.
    - `WallpaperBridgeProvider` (`com.emmanuel.tvhome.wallpaper_bridge`, `android:permission="com.emmanuel.tvhome.permission.WALLPAPER_SYNC"`): Accepts `ParcelFileDescriptor` writes (`home` / `screensaver` <=15 MB), validates decodability (`BitmapFactory` `inJustDecodeBounds`), commits atomically via `.tmp` rename, and triggers `status`/`apply`/`clear` bundles.

### 4.4 UI/UX Styling Rules & Custom Optimizations
- **Themes & Surfaces**: `Theme.TvHome` (fullscreen black, `Animation.TvHome.AppTransition`), `Theme.TvHome.Translucent.Morph` (transparent background, `@null` window animation so `WindowMorph` owns every frame cleanly).
- **Top Bar Pills & Settings Rows (`styles.xml`)**:
  - `TopButtonBase`: `42dp` height, `@drawable/pill_bg`, `15sp`, `@string/font_medium`. `TopButtonIcon`: `42x42dp` circular icon button.
  - `SettingsRow`: `52dp` height (`56dp` minHeight on two-line toggle rows), `@drawable/settings_choice_bg`, `18sp` `#FFE3E2E6` primary / `#FFC4C6D0` secondary / `#FFA8C7FA` section headers over `#FF111318` background.
- **Hardware Build & Bytecode Optimizations (`app/build.gradle` + `proguard-rules.pro`)**:
  - Disabled unused Android build features (`buildConfig false`, `aidl false`, `renderScript false`, `shaders false`, `dependenciesInfo includeInApk=false`).
  - R8 5-pass optimization, class repackaging, `Log.d/v/i` assumption-no-side-effects removal.
  - Post-build Gradle task `optimizeReleaseApk`: Strips `version-control-info.textproto` and `app-metadata.properties`, runs `aapt2 optimize --collapse-resource-names` (preserving `banner_*`) `--deduplicate-entry-values`, runs `zipalign -z -p -f 4` (Zopfli recompression), signs v2-only (`--v1-signing-enabled false --v3-signing-enabled false --v4-signing-enabled false`), verifies signature, and enforces hard APK size gate (`720,896 B` for `tv-launcher`; actual v7.2 size: `693,683 B`).

####################################################################################################
## SECTION 5. BUG FIXES, REFACTORS & EDGE CASES HANDLED
####################################################################################################

1. **Sideways D-Pad Scroll Jump Fix (`tv-launcher` `cb6db3b`, `GridNavigation.verticalRevealDy`)**:
   - *Issue*: Moving sideways across lower grid rows triggered unexpected vertical scroll jumps because `RecyclerView.requestChildFocus` passed only the inner card rect rather than the item wrapper bottom + glass highlight padding.
   - *Fix*: `GridNavigation.verticalRevealDy` computes reveal delta against `Math.max(childBottom + glassPad, childTop + rectTop + rectHeight)` so scrolling Down settles cleanly on first arrival and sideways movement produces `0 px` vertical drift.
2. **Haier Remote Button Mappings & Precedence Fixes (`tv-launcher` `cb6db3b`, parent `5e89d526`, `de8421d6`, `f9eb6b45`)**:
   - *Issue*: Disabling the stock launcher broke physical Netflix/YouTube/Prime/Hotstar/Guide/Settings/Input buttons or caused scancode 240 collisions with HDMI input switching.
   - *Fix*: Centralized remote routing in `RemoteKeys`, prioritized `InputKeyService.isInputKey()` ahead of `scan:240`, added cross-service `ACTION_UP` deduplication across `HomeKeyService` / `InputKeyService` / `MainActivity`, stripped diagnostic `Log.d("TVHOME_KEY")` at release compile time via R8, and restored Haier `settings_key_keycodes` `[80, 83]` + `app_keys`.
3. **Restored Hero & Ambient Effects + Granular 15-Animation Controls (`tv-launcher` v7.0 -> v7.2)**:
   - *Issue*: Earlier minimalist presets disabled hero/ambient lighting or tied all motion behind a single coarse switch, and Launcher Settings wasn't directly accessible as an app grid card.
   - *Fix*: Restored `cinematic_home=true`, `ambient_glow=true`, `app_glow=true`, `advanced_effects=true`; added `Entry.LAUNCHER_SETTINGS` tile anchored non-movable at the tail of the grid; replaced single toggle behavior with 15 independent `ANIM_*_KEY` toggles wired into `MainActivity`, `AppAdapter`, `AppLibraryDialog`, `QuickSettingsActivity`, `NotificationPanelActivity`, `LauncherSettingsActivity`, `HomeKeyService`, `WallpaperPlayer`, `ClockActivity`, and `ClockScene`.
4. **Android 11–14 Scoped Storage & Accessibility Kill Edge Cases**:
   - Firmware blocking `adb push` into `Android/data` worked around via `ThemeProvider` (`WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS`).
   - Stock settings/cleaner `force-stop` wiping accessibility services resolved by `ServiceRepair` + `GuardKeep` (`restore_key_services`) + `GuardRevival` (`NotificationListenerService` reviving process).
   - Android 14 `SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM` revocation worked around in `SleepTimer` using `AlarmManager.setWindow(..., 60_000, ...)`.
5. **Memory & GPU Optimizations for Low-End TVs (1–2 GB RAM / Mali GPU)**:
   - Replaced full-res backdrop painting with `480x270`/`240x135` scaled `SkyView` and pre-baked `dimColor` inside `WallpaperPlayer` bitmap decode.
   - Switched `LastOpened` `UsageStatsManager` scans to 60s-throttled application-context background thread (`LauncherExecutors`) fixing Activity context leaks.
   - Discrete 16-step `ClockScene` ambient glow updates (`500ms`) avoid 60 fps full-screen shader churn during idle screensaver.
6. **`tv_server` & `companion` Stability Hardening (`d3e85544`)**:
   - Added `5000 ms` TCP handshake `SoTimeout`, drained `screenrecord` stderr on a daemon thread to prevent pipe stalls, closed client socket immediately on encoder exit, capped `NalParser` at 4 MB & cached SPS/PPS for mid-stream attach, bounded `VideoDecoder` latency map to 64 entries (`LinkedHashMap`), cleaned up `TouchpadController` on detach, and rejected invalid/public IPs in `IpValidator`.
7. **`addons/` Lifecycle & Threading Fixes (`13454f41`) & Tooling Hygiene (`23a83103`)**:
   - Fixed lifecycle leaks, main-thread blocking, and `.ps1`/`.sh` script edge cases across all 22 add-ons; hardened ADB helpers and test scanners.
